prompt: A young cleric in white-and-gold vestments has collapsed to her knees at the moment of death, head fallen back, on the marble floor of a cathedral. From a wound in her chest a vertical shaft of holy gold-white light erupts upward in crepuscular rays, her life force leaving her body and rising toward the high windows. Faint golden motes drift up in the beam. The background is a dim cathedral nave with stone columns. The only source of light is the radiant golden beam pouring out of her.

A robed saint run through by a spear, arms fallen open in a cruciform martyr pose, suspended mid-collapse. Instead of crimson blood, the wound streams gold-white light-motes and pale doves upward into the dark. The figure wears bone-white vestments with gold trim, head bowed. The background is a shadowed stone shrine at night. The only source of light is the rising stream of holy golden light from the wound.

Two figures on a battlefield at dusk, both fully visible. On the left, a white-robed cleric has fallen dying to the ground, gold-white light pouring out of her body. That stream of holy light flows rightward into a wounded kneeling soldier, whose wounds are closing as the radiance restores him and he rises. The cleric is bone-white and gold; the soldier is in grey steel armor. The background is a dim battlefield with smoke. The only source of light is the golden healing stream passing from the dying cleric to the soldier.

A young cleric in white-and-gold vestments slumped dying against a fallen stone column, head lolling, one hand pressed to a wound in her chest. From between her fingers a vertical shaft of holy gold-white light bursts upward in crepuscular rays, her life rising out of her. Golden motes spiral up the beam. The background is a ruined chapel with broken arches at dusk. The only source of light is the golden radiance pouring from her wound.
